hub.description: The notes area (label hub): scopes, listing, searching, reading and writing notes that are not on the desktop, creating, renaming, deleting and restoring them, colors, putting a note on the desktop and taking it back, exporting through the backend's save dialog, showing a note or a notes folder in the file manager, copying a note or text that is not saved through the backend, answering the backend's save requests, the settings, its own always on top state, whether its sidebar is open, its width and the project it showed last, the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, listening to the backend's events. No core:window permission is granted, and no dialog or clipboard permission: those plugins are used from the backend only.

note.description: A sticky note (label note-<scope>-<id>): reading and writing its own note, renaming it after its first line, its color and keep on top, deleting and closing itself (the backend refuses any other note), answering the backend's save requests, a new sticky note next to it, opening the notes area, copying its text through the backend when it cannot save, the status and the settings, the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, moving the frameless window by its header (start dragging) and listening to the backend's events.
